expected_results_origin: Manually specified teaching expectations; checked independently in Python, not exported from Power Query or Excel.

interpretation.source_row: One-based data-record index after the header; not a general physical CSV line number.
interpretation.inspection_id: Text identifier of one inspection event within this exercise; duplicates are preserved and flagged for review.
interpretation.ready_for_demo: Meets this fixture's data checks only; no product-acceptance or pass-rate conclusion.
interpretation.source_result: Preserved source label; never computed from the numerical reading.
interpretation.issue_occurrences: Multiple issues can affect one row, so issue counts are not a partition of row counts.
interpretation.blank_normalized_cells: Empty CSV cells represent null only for InspectionID, InspectionDate, ReadingNumber and ReadingMM. Blank Unit and SourceResult are empty text.
interpretation.unsupported_unit: inch is deliberately outside this two-unit exercise, not a claim that the unit is invalid or cannot be converted.
